item.title: New Workflow Test WTF
item.description: If this post actually gets posted it means that my new workflow actually works. Apparently people far smarter than I am have already figured out a better way of hosting Hugo websites through github pages. If I am reading the documentation correctly all I will have to do is write my post, commit it to the Github Pages repository and then push those changes to Github. I won’t even need to run hugo build.
